headline: Apple Introduces New Touchscreen MacBook Pro Lineup in South Africa
summary: Apple has officially released South African pricing for its new touchscreen MacBook Pro lineup, with prices ranging from R60,999 up to R100,999 alongside an M6 entry model.
why: Apple is a major multinational technology company whose product pricing and hardware releases in emerging markets reflect global hardware demand and regional distribution strategies.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: New product pricing in South Africa represents a local market launch for Apple hardware.
